guards.note: SHARED-FINDINGS section 3 (MoveState ids differ between the two sides). The one cross-file reader of a sim move id is CreatureCmd.stun's next_move_key (cmds.py:216-217), which assigns straight into `target._move_key`. Executed: the only ported caller that passes a next_move_key at all is sts2_rl/monsters/overgrowth/ceremonial_beast.py:45 (next_move_key="BEAST_CRY", its own id), so no cross-file reference reaches this unit's ids and the rename is unobservable. Dormant trigger: any future stun source that names a C# MoveState id. AxeRubyRaider is the one batch-2 port with no `_move_key` attribute at all, so cmds.py:217's `hasattr(target, "_move_key")` guard would silently skip it if a stun ever named its move - dormant for the same executed reason (no ported caller passes a next_move_key to it).
No max-HP write on either side.
